seed.tagline: Backend, auth and docs, plus migrations, conformance and an audit trail.
seed.description: A package: installs the Backend API, AuthN / AuthZ and Documentation add-ins, and adds an enterprise/ folder for regulated work: Postgres migration SQL between a live database and the next version (postgres-diff-migration, run on demand), the gold-answer-key conformance check, and audit-policy.json recording the retention period and audited tables the rulebook's AuditEvents table is expected to cover.
seed.requiresInput: A magic-link tenant id and the rulebook's Security module

replacements.label: Audit retention (days)
replacements.description: How long audit events are kept. 2555 days is seven years.

replacements.label: Audited tables
replacements.description: Comma-separated rulebook tables whose changes must be written to the audit trail. Blank means every table.
